title: Звонок в восемь шагов
purpose: The lead advisor's ten-slide training deck on taking a call.
russian_form: the lead advisor's ten-slide training deck
differs_from_en: Ten slides in slot 16's Russian voice. Slide 9, the three sentences: «Без проблем», «Должно быть готово», «У нас на всё гарантия».
Slide 6 uses the Russian brake-inspection price (700 RUB); slide 8 names the Russian warranty (30 days on the work, the maker's on the part).
